valence and arousal as the dimensions

satisfied_inclusion_points: The paper uses a ranking-based approach to emotion recognition in music, directly ranking a collection of music pieces by emotion rather than assigning absolute emotion values.
It develops a learning-to-rank algorithm (RBF-ListNet) to rank music pieces by emotion, which is applied within the audio domain (music organization and retrieval).
The work is not a survey or review; it presents a novel method with empirical evaluation and analysis.
evidence_highlights: ranking-based emotion annotation and the proposed RBF-ListNet ranking model
music emotion tournament using pairwise comparisons to build a ranking
empirical evaluation including Gamma statistics (0.326) and subjective assessments
